profile_text.body:
CDW is a public company, traded under the ticker CDW, that describes itself as a provider of information technology products, expertise and services for business. Its site emphasizes fast shipping, fast answers, large in-stock inventories and custom configurations, covering hardware and software alongside services.

The AI material on the site is largely framed around readiness and deployment rather than products CDW builds itself. CDW says it offers expertise to deploy, manage and scale Surface Laptops, which it describes as combining AI-ready performance, security and productivity. It highlights Microsoft Surface Copilot+ PCs as AI-driven productivity tools with enterprise-grade security, the Logitech Rally AI Camera and Rally AI Camera Pro for video collaboration, and Mac mini with the M6 chip for on-device AI workflows. Other site content addresses data quality and governance as a foundation for trusted AI, infrastructure modernization for AI readiness, shifting legacy data centers toward AI initiatives in the public sector, and people-first AI strategies in retail.

The company's record includes a SEC Central Index Key, 0001402057. No litigation, no tracked products and no MCP servers are recorded for CDW.
